central_rule: A response is not prevention until named owners implement the change in the live process, affected people and records are repaired where warranted, independent evidence verifies operation, and recurrence and missing populations are reviewed.
interpretive_law: A recommendation is not an implementation plan.
A response received is not a response publicly recoverable.
A response publicly recoverable is not a live-process change.
Training delivered is not prevention verified.
Policy existence is not policy operation.
Worker restoration is not system correction.
An official non-response register does not prove implementation for names absent from it.
A surviving workforce is not the complete affected population.
purpose: Audit whether public findings, recommendations, responses, training, and policy changes become owned live-process changes, worker repair, independent verification, recurrence control, and affected-population learning.
title: Response-to-prevention custody and implementation verification
